levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The outline is one closed loop with no gaps, no overlapping ends, and no leftover or stray entities inside the perimeter.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The outline is one closed loop, with one or two stray entities left behind in the sketch.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The outline has a visible gap or overlapping ends at one location.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No outline drawn, or the outline is open at more than one location.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The hole is a closed circle set in from the outline with material visible all the way around it, and the entire design sits inside the square perimeter.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The hole is closed but nearly touches the outline, or the hole is not closed, or part of the design crosses the square perimeter.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No hole drawn.

criterion: Sketch the Outline: Hole and containment

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The part is extruded and saved, and the exported DXF opens in xTool Studio showing the outline and the hole as two closed paths at the size drawn in SolidWorks.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The DXF opens with the outline and hole both present, but at a size that does not match the SolidWorks sketch.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The DXF opens with geometry missing, or with more than the flat face exported.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No extrude performed, or no DXF produced, or the file does not open.

criterion: Extrude and Export the DXF: Extrude and DXF export

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Name plus at least one added element, text or image, is placed, and every added element sits fully inside the outline.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A name is placed with nothing else added, or an added element crosses or touches the outline.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Nothing added to the imported shape.

criterion: Set Up the Job in xTool Studio: Personalization

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every feature carries a process, with cut assigned to the outline and the hole and score or engrave assigned to everything added.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every feature carries a process, but cut is assigned to a feature other than the outline or the hole.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One or more features carry no process.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No processes assigned, or the machine was never set to xTool MetalFab.

criterion: Set Up the Job in xTool Studio: Process assignment

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the process assigned to the outline, to the hole, and to one added feature, and names one specific thing that could go wrong on this tag.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Names the process for only some of the three features, or names all three but gives no risk, or gives a risk that is not specific to this tag.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Not answered.

criterion: Hand Off the File: Reads the job off the preview
